exposure: multimodal perinatal education program (physical workshops, digital learning platform, personalized counseling sessions)
outcome: Birth Preparedness and Complication Readiness (BPCR) scores
cohort: 149 rural primiparous women, aged 18-49 years with rural household registration, identified from patient records between January 2021 and December 2022.
finding: The holistic perinatal education program significantly improved birth preparedness knowledge and practice, reduced depressive and anxiety symptoms, and positively impacted birth outcomes among rural primiparous women.
mod_finding: The intervention group demonstrated a higher rate of vaginal births and fewer maternal indications for cesarean deliveries compared to the control group.
